legend: Mixed germ cell–sex cord–stromal tumour showing an admixture of germ cell and sex cord components arranged in a haphazard fashion. The germ cells are large, with pleomorphic nuclei and ample cytoplasm, resembling dysgerminoma tumour cells. The smaller sex cord cells surround the germ cells, forming cords or trabeculae.
source: Dr Asma Z. Faruqi, Consultant Histopathologist, Barts Health NHS Trust, 80 Newark Street, London E1 2ES, United Kingdom

legend: Mixed germ cell–sex cord–stromal tumour, unclassified, showing an admixture of germ cells and sex cord cells (top left and right). Sex cord cells also grow in clustered hollow or solid tubules (centre and bottom).
source: Dr Asma Z. Faruqi, Consultant Histopathologist, Barts Health NHS Trust, 80 Newark Street, London E1 2ES, United Kingdom
